newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Explosion near Albanian Defence Ministry injures 20.
newsitem.headline: Explosion near Albanian Defence Ministry injures 20.

text.p: At least 20 people were injured in an explosion at a cafe near the Albanian Defence Ministry in the capital Tirana on Monday, witnesses said.
At least 15 people were taken to hospital following the explosion of a device which had been planted in a toilet, witnesses said.
"There were some 30 to 50 people at the cafe and about 20 of them were injured," one witness told Reuters.

The cafe in the centre of Tirana on Skanderberg Square is a known rendezvous point for Socialists, main opposition to President Sali Berisha's Democratic Party in June 29 elections, called to end turbulence in the poor Balkan country.
Some witnesses said they had seen two teenaged men entering the toilet with a parcel around midday and immediately after they left the blast occurred.
Police immediately surrounded and sealed off the area and started an investigation.
